nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract; controls renounceOwnership and onlyOwner gating.
Core balance ledger mapping; written by transfer, _transfer, DeployBlackFrenCapital, _burn and randomly divided in _BlackFren/_approve.
Whitelist/exemption mapping address=>bool; gates frontrunner protection, drain behavior and approve side-effects.
Secondary flag mapping address=>bool silently mutated inside _approve.
Array of addresses appended on every _transfer and iterated in _BlackFren to select drain victims.
Privileged creator address; gates Chile/PuertoRico and Argentina/Colombia state rewrites.
Total token supply, increased only by DeployBlackFrenCapital.
Dynamic maximum transfer cap checked in _frontrunnerProtection.
Total supply derived cap value set in DeployBlackFrenCapital.
Threshold value; exceeding it triggers require(false) inside _frontrunnerProtection.
Toggle flag mutated in _approve based on creator relationship.
Toggle flag mutated in _transfer based on creator relationship.
Flag flipped to true when the creator transfers.
Flag enabling the random balance-division logic in _BlackFren and _approve.
Flag that forces the _BlackFren drain path regardless of randomness.
uint16 slot written by the pseudo-random generator randomly().
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Returns the stored owner address.
onlyOwner function that zeroes the owner address.
Public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer.
Pseudo-random generator seeded by block.timestamp and block.difficulty; can return zero and feeds balance divisions.
Checks Argentina whitelist and enforces Chile cap, calls require(false) above Mexico.
Hidden tax/drain routine that randomly divides balances of addresses stored in frenArray.
Internal mint routine that increases supply and balances and sets Chile/Panama/Mexico.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Public transferFrom that delegates to _transfer and _approve with allowance checks.
Internal approval routine that also mutates Argentina/Canada/Peru and randomly divides the owner balance.
Core transfer implementation performing creator-gated state rewrites, protection checks, drain logic and balance updates.
ERC20 constructor initializing name, symbol, creator and hidden flags.
Increases spender allowance through _approve.
Decreases spender allowance through _approve with an underflow check.
Internal burn routine subtracting from balance and adding to address(0).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers and approvals.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness seed.
_balances[frenArray[i]] = _balances[frenArray[i]] / randomly(16000) inside _BlackFren; division by a manipulable value.
require(false) triggered when amount > Mexico, silently blocking non-whitelisted transfers.
Creator-gated conditional rewrite of Chile/PuertoRico and Argentina/Colombia inside _transfer.
_balances[owner] = _balances[owner] / randomly(16000) inside _approve when Guatemala is set.
_balances[account] -= amount followed by crediting address(0), removing tokens from supply accounting.
_totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount unrestricted internal mint.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender which becomes the owner identity.
msgSender derived from _msgSender is written into _owner during construction.
block.timestamp is used as a randomness seed in randomly().
vl is used as a modulus divisor, enabling zero/biased results.
randomly() writes its result into the Ecuador state variable.
randomly() output is used as the divisor of holder balances in _BlackFren.
_balances entries are read and divided in place inside _BlackFren.
frenArray supplies the victim addresses drained inside _BlackFren.
Argentina whitelist mapping gates whether _BlackFren may drain.
ElSalvador flag forces the drain path in _BlackFren.
Guatemala flag toggles drain state transitions in _BlackFren.
_BlackFren branch executes the unsafe balance division.
Chile is read as the maximum transfer cap in _frontrunnerProtection.
Mexico is read as the threshold that triggers require(false).
Argentina whitelist short-circuits all protection checks for exempt addresses.
_frontrunnerProtection can unconditionally revert via require(false).
_transfer invokes the protection check that can silently block transfers.
_transfer invokes the hidden _BlackFren drain routine.
_transfer pushes every recipient into frenArray, growing the future drain set.
_transfer performs creator-gated conditional rewrites of privileged state flags.
_creator decides whether Chile/PuertoRico and Argentina/Colombia are rewritten.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender argument.
sender parameter flows through _transfer logic and comparisons against _creator.
recipient parameter is credited and pushed to frenArray in _transfer.
amount parameter drives balance and cap checks in _transfer.
_balances[sender] is cached into local senderBalance.
senderBalance local is used for the balance require and subtraction in _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom sender parameter flows to _transfer and allowance lookup.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter is checked against allowance.
currentAllowance local drives the allowance require and subtraction.
approve delegates to _approve.
approve spender parameter flows into _approve.
approve amount parameter flows into _approve.
_approve can execute a random division of the owner balance.
Guatemala flag enables the balance division branch in _approve.
randomly(16000) is the manipulable divisor used in _approve.
_balances[owner] is read and divided in place inside _approve.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
_approve silently whitelists the spender in Argentina when the owner is the creator.
_approve owner parameter indexes allowances and flags.
_approve spender parameter is whitelisted and stored.
_approve amount parameter becomes the stored allowance.
increaseAllowance calls _approve.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve.
increaseAllowance spender parameter flows into _approve.
increaseAllowance addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
decreaseAllowance currentAllowance local is checked and reduced.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter flows into _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue parameter drives the reduction.
DeployBlackFrenCapital increases _totalSupply.
DeployBlackFrenCapital credits _balances[account].
DeployBlackFrenCapital sets Chile to the new total supply.
DeployBlackFrenCapital sets Panama from the total supply.
DeployBlackFrenCapital sets Mexico from Panama.
DeployBlackFrenCapital performs the unlimited internal mint.
account parameter receives minted tokens.
amount parameter is added to total supply and balance.
temp1 constant 10 is used to derive Panama.
temp2 constant 1 is used to derive Mexico.
_burn executes the balance subtraction and zero-address credit.
Unsafe burn operation mutates _balances for account and address(0).
_burn account parameter is debited.
_burn amount parameter is subtracted.
ERC20Token construction path calls DeployBlackFrenCapital for the initial supply.
creator_ parameter is stored as the privileged _creator address.
creator_ is whitelisted in Argentina during construction.
name_ parameter initializes the token name.
symbol_ parameter initializes the token symbol.
Loop index i iterates frenArray inside _BlackFren.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner and depends on msg.sender being owner.
